# Portfolio Workspace Instructions

- Project: Next.js 16 with TypeScript and App Router.
- Current goal: build a personal portfolio for Mr. Sanchit Das.
- Keep changes focused on the portfolio homepage unless the user asks for more pages.
- Use the existing visual direction: dark, premium, responsive, and easy to extend.
- When the user adds content, update the copy, sections, and metadata to match.
- Prefer small, targeted edits over broad rewrites.
- Run lint and build checks after meaningful code changes.
